purpose: Attempt to recover geometry-enabling primary data for the three highest-ranked R1 residuals. R2 cannot promote a case using additional testimony, later narrative synthesis, or a reanalysis that substitutes assumptions for missing sensor records.
transparency_note: The R2 target set and priority order were frozen in R1 before R2 began. A targeted RB-47 discovery search was already underway before this standalone contract file was committed; this is recorded rather than presented as a blind preregistration.

required_data_classes.D0_CONTEMPORANEOUS_PRIMARY_REPORT: Official report created near the event, not only retrospective testimony.
required_data_classes.D1_RAW_SENSOR_RECORD: Raw or minimally processed radar/ELINT/IR/optical/avionics data with preserved timebase.
required_data_classes.D2_SENSOR_CALIBRATION_CONFIGURATION: Mode, field of view, frequency, scan geometry, gain/range settings, platform state or equivalent information needed to interpret D1.
required_data_classes.D3_PLATFORM_NAVIGATION_TIMEBASE: Position, velocity, attitude and synchronized timestamps sufficient to reconstruct observer geometry.
required_data_classes.D4_CROSS_SENSOR_SYNCHRONIZATION: Records that independently bind two or more channels to the same event/object on a common timebase.
required_data_classes.D5_ENVIRONMENT_TRAFFIC_CONTROLS: Weather, astronomical, aircraft/balloon/traffic and propagation context sufficient to attack ordinary alternatives.

promotion_gate: A case may reopen G3/G6 from R1 only if public primary material supplies D1 plus enough of D2-D4 to calculate at least one physical parameter with an explicit uncertainty interval. D0 alone is insufficient.

specific_targets: Major Chase AISOP #2 Airborne Observer Data Sheet

primary_repositories: Department of the Navy/SECNAV FOIA Reading Room
specific_targets: original ATFLIR file/metadata beyond public video
F-4 radar tape or scope recording

result_states.RECOVERED_GEOMETRY_ENABLING_PRIMARY_DATA: At least D1 plus sufficient D2-D4 recovered publicly.
result_states.CONTEMPORANEOUS_REPORTS_ONLY: D0 recovered but no geometry-enabling sensor record.
result_states.PUBLIC_ARCHIVE_SERIES_IDENTIFIED_NOT_DIG: Official custody is known but target bytes were not obtained in this run.
result_states.NOT_FOUND_IN_SEARCHED_PUBLIC_OFFICIAL_SO: No qualifying primary data found in the enumerated official public sources; this does not prove nonexistence elsewhere.
result_states.KNOWN_UNRELEASED_OR_LOCATION_UNKNOWN: An official/hearing source explicitly describes a relevant record as unreleased, missing, or of unknown location.

stop_rule: After each frozen target has an inventory across D0-D5 and the named official public repositories have been searched, freeze R2. Do not widen to additional cases or testimony-only sources to manufacture a recovery.
claim_ceiling: Failure to recover public raw data is an evidence-access result, not evidence that an event was ordinary and not evidence of concealment.
canonical_seal: REPORTS CAN PRESERVE AN EVENT. ONLY MEASUREMENTS CAN RECONSTRUCT ITS PHYSICS. R2 RECOVERS MEASUREMENTS OR RECORDS THEIR PUBLIC ABSENCE; IT DOES NOT REPLACE THEM WITH STORIES.
